name: The goose affair
text: Your first scheme came off. Bruges will be talking about the goose for a week.

name: Somebody's name
text: Level 5. People in the Waterhalle have started to know your face.

name: A man of Bruges
text: Level 10. The Charetty household no longer calls you a boy.

name: A man of Europe
text: Level 20. Venice keeps a file on you.

name: A fortune
text: A hundred thousand groats in hand. Marian would not believe it.

name: Felix put down
text: Felix de Charetty, on his back at last. He laughed, which you did not expect.

name: St Pol humbled
text: Simon de St Pol beaten in the street. The vendetta will not end here.

name: The vicomte
text: Jordan de Ribérac beaten. Nobody in Bruges believes it, and nobody says so to your face.

name: Guest of the Steen
text: Your first night in the town prison.

name: Nicholas vander Poele
text: Claes the apprentice is gone. Married to the demoiselle de Charetty, master of the company.
